verdict.rationale: Workers supports event-driven automation via cron triggers, Queues, and durable Workflows, plus bindings to external services, letting developers wire actions to events (cloudflare-docs-9, cloudflare-docs-10). However, this requires writing code rather than a declarative 'rules engine' UI, and community feedback notes friction with long-running agent workflows and vendor lock-in around bindings (cloudflare-comm-9, cloudflare-comm-10), so it's a capable but developer-centric automation substrate rather than a turnkey rules system.
